controls.persistence: undoable holds; not pins or .draft source
controls.current_docs: docs/DSL.md:Layout tools; Editing in the viewer
controls.gap: Holds protect later editor runs until cleared/document changes; file source rebuild does not serialize holds.

controls.defaults: Before brush unless timeline/bookmark exists
controls.applicability: brush restore
controls.persistence: session geometry reference only
controls.current_docs: docs/DSL.md:Layout tools; Editing in the viewer
controls.gap: Capture before change; restore on unchanged geometry is expected no-op.

controls.defaults: none initially
controls.applicability: brush holds
controls.persistence: undoable session state; explicit pins unchanged
controls.current_docs: docs/DSL.md:Layout tools; Editing in the viewer
controls.gap: Show hold count and next pass; clearing does not unpin nodes.

controls.values: temporarily Restore; in Hold mode remove holds
controls.defaults: off
controls.applicability: pointer strokes; excludes protect-to-restore conversion
controls.persistence: same stroke undo unit
controls.current_docs: docs/DSL.md:Layout tools; Editing in the viewer
controls.gap: Show normal/Alt; pin protection remains.

controls.values: one deterministic local action at hovered point or canvas center
controls.defaults: no dab until keypress
controls.applicability: active brush
controls.persistence: one undo geometry/hold edit
controls.current_docs: docs/DSL.md:Layout tools; Editing in the viewer
controls.gap: Use fixed zoom and named target center in runnable editor recipe to avoid timing variance.

controls.defaults: current settings/scope, after stroke committed
controls.applicability: brush dock
controls.persistence: new preview; no commit until Keep
controls.current_docs: docs/DSL.md:Layout tools; Editing in the viewer
controls.gap: Separate local editing from new global preview; check holds constraint on normal engine path.

controls.defaults: keep up to4 differing candidates plus v0; prefer fewer-crossings; no time budget
controls.applicability: whole-file/source variants; default engine compound-flow if groups else layered
controls.persistence: writes output files only until --apply
controls.gap: Automatically may soften groups/drop blamed refinements/alter compare panel direction; inspect exact edits.

controls.defaults: bare key uses Explorer steps or categorical choices; standoff requires explicit values
controls.applicability: cold source compiles; source order, comments and refinements retained
controls.persistence: variants saved; no input mutation
controls.gap: Not equivalent to editor rebuild removing soft refinements; --try root unsupported; see canonical L/R rows for every key.

controls.values: layered,compound-flow,flow each right/down; adds tree if graph is tree
controls.defaults: off
controls.applicability: root/group; lanes may be replaced; sequence/cells blocked
controls.persistence: source variants only
controls.gap: Broad sweep not exhaustive ten-engine atlas; every candidate including repeats retained.

controls.defaults: root, or previous variant layout scope for --from
controls.applicability: layout changes scoped; routing settings remain global; soft/none frame rejected
controls.persistence: candidate layout line only; geometry outside group can change through size propagation
controls.gap: Not geometry freeze outside group; CLI explicit routing axis still global under scope.

controls.defaults: unset
controls.applicability: candidate suggestions/ranking; does not insert DSL layout fit
controls.persistence: goal not saved by apply unless edits themselves set aspect/direction
controls.gap: All five target states; contrast layout fit and engine aspect; permits <=50% area growth only when other constraints hold.

controls.defaults: fewer-crossings
controls.applicability: sort order after warnings and optional fit, subject to hard recommendation guard
controls.persistence: saved output metadata only
controls.gap: All three states may choose v0; preference cannot authorize larger diagram just to remove crossing without fit guard.

controls.values: saved variant ID or best from prior run; mutually exclusive try/grid
controls.defaults: unset
controls.applicability: search neighbours of prior edits; source hash must still match
controls.persistence: replaces candidate output; input unchanged
controls.gap: IDs reassigned each run. Use same --out folder for prior manifest; --from reads it before overwriting outputs. best resolves prior recommendation.

controls.values: nonnegative number with ms/s/m; bare seconds
controls.defaults: unlimited
controls.applicability: stop starting new candidates after time; does not cancel active computation or v0 compile
controls.persistence: manifest records tried/skipped
controls.gap: 0/60s/2m useful demonstration; runtime cutoff is approximate and machine-dependent, not fixed candidate count.

controls.applicability: suggest/from only; explicit try/grid keeps up to12 regardless limit
controls.persistence: output retention only
controls.gap: 1/4/12; no quality effect, only retained candidates.

controls.defaults: FILE basename .vary beside input
controls.applicability: all vary outputs/apply/from lookup
controls.persistence: contact-sheet.png,vN.png,variants.json; existing vN PNGs removed on rerun
controls.gap: Nonvisual output plumbing; use unique atlas directories and keep per-run manifest.

controls.defaults: false
controls.applicability: stdout manifest instead of table; stderr progress remains
controls.persistence: JSON output file always written
controls.gap: Nonvisual machine-readable reproducibility; actual JSON records original source hash, not full source.

controls.defaults: false (source embedded)
controls.applicability: per-variant PNGs
controls.persistence: omits embedded .draft; separate atlas fixture must remain
controls.gap: Nonvisual export metadata; contact sheet itself has no per-diagram editable source embedding.

controls.values: v0 or saved vN or best
controls.defaults: no input mutation without flag
controls.applicability: checks exact input-source hash; changes only saved line edits then checks
controls.persistence: writes .draft; CLI action has no application Undo, use VCS/file copy
controls.gap: Show before/after diff; --apply best may be v0; editor Apply has different refinement semantics.

controls.values: metrics flag; optional five fit values
controls.defaults: normal check excludes extra quality notes; fit used only with metrics
controls.applicability: compiled output diagnostics plus crossings/detour/stranded/aspect notes
controls.persistence: read-only
controls.gap: Warnings are not exit1; quality-note warning counts differ from vary counts; use as evidence not visual quality ranking alone.

controls.values: unrefined vs final positions and pushed nodes
controls.defaults: off
controls.applicability: diagnose soft/hard refinement impact
controls.persistence: read-only
controls.gap: Pairs with before/after visual; one node may move because another refinement pushes it.

controls.values: canonical geometry with metrics; real rendered SVG
controls.defaults: inspect default pretty geometry; SVG explicit
controls.applicability: all .draft fixture renders
controls.persistence: stdout; save to companion file
controls.gap: Do not confuse metrics equality with byte-equal geometry; verify geometry assertions independent of screenshot.

controls.values: remove relaxed-warning refinements and stale stays; --write commits
controls.defaults: off; output-only without write
controls.applicability: refinement cleanup
controls.persistence: source changes only with --write; dropped lines stderr
controls.gap: Show cleanup diff plus rendered result; not generic remove-all-manual.
